title: From Self-Confidence to Statistical Accuracy: Scaling Human-in-the-Loop Evaluation with Direct and LLM-Assisted Auditing
abstract: arXiv:2610.35698v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: For large language models (LLMs) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs), model-reported self-confidence is often miscalibrated, yet it may still be useful for efficient evaluation. At the same time, LLM-as-a-judge offers a scalable alternative to direct human auditing, but its practical benefit depends on calibration quality and inference cost.   This paper develops a unified statistical framework for both evaluation routes under alternative sampling strategies. For direct auditing, confidence-stratified sampling is used to recover population accuracy from partially verified outputs without requiring calibrated confidence. Finite-sample uncertainty is characterized, and the analysis shows how highly uneven confidence strata affect audit efficiency and label allocation. For judge-assisted evaluation, the judge is modeled through sensitivity and false-positive rate, yielding an error-corrected estimator with calibration uncertainty.

translated_title: 从自信度到统计准确性：通过直接审计与LLM辅助审计扩展人机协同评估
translated_abstract: 对于大型语言模型（LLM）和多模态大型语言模型（MLLM），模型报告的自信度往往校准不准，但它仍可能对高效评估有所帮助。与此同时，LLM-as-a-judge（以LLM作为评判者）为直接人工审计提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但其实际收益取决于校准质量和推理成本。本文开发了一个统一的统计框架，用于分析在不同抽样策略下的这两种评估路线。对于直接审计，采用置信度分层抽样从部分验证的输出中恢复总体准确率，而无需校准的置信度。论文刻画了有限样本下的不确定性，并分析了高度不均衡的置信度分层如何影响审计效率和标签分配。对于评判者辅助评估，通过灵敏度和假阳性率对评判者进行建模，得到一个带校准不确定性的误差校正估计量。
tldr: 该论文提出统一统计框架，通过置信度分层抽样实现无需校准置信度的直接人工审计，并基于灵敏度和假阳性率建模LLM评判者构建误差校正估计量，从而实现可扩展的人机协同模型评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified statistical framework for scalable human-in-the-loop evaluation, using confidence-stratified sampling for direct auditing without requiring calibrated confidence and an error-corrected estimator for LLM-judge-assisted evaluation based on sensitivity and false-positive rate modeling.
